name: Amazing Las Vegas Comic Con
blurb: Las Vegas's long-running comic and pop-culture convention at The Orleans Hotel, with guest signings, exhibitors and panels.
notes: Homepage still shows only the already-past edition ('AMAZING LAS VEGAS COMIC CON May 29-30-31, 2026 The Orleans Hotel'); no 2027 dates are posted on the site and a search found only a third-party aggregator guessing 'likely May 2027' with no official confirmation, so editions is empty and the last confirmed edition is recorded instead. The same homepage also promotes a separate 'Amazing Comic Con Aloha' show in Hawaii ('More info coming soon!'); that is a different city under the same organizer/brand and is out of scope for this file.
